people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: They traveled, and a terror of God was on the cities that were around them, and they didn’t pursue the sons of Jacob.
translations.bsb: As they set out, a terror from God fell over the surrounding cities, so that they did not pursue Jacob’s sons.
translations.kjv: And they journeyed: and the terror of God was upon the cities that were round about them, and they did not pursue after the sons of Jacob.
translations.asv: And they journeyed: and a terror of God was upon the cities that were round about them, and they did not pursue after the sons of Jacob.
